reasoning: As of my knowledge cutoff (April 2024), NASA's Artemis program aims to return humans to the moon. Artemis II (crewed lunar orbit) was scheduled for late 2024/early 2025, with Artemis III (lunar landing) targeted for 2025-2026. However, the program has experienced delays. A 2025 landing requires Artemis II to launch successfully first, then Artemis III to launch and land within the same year. This timeline is extremely tight and historically NASA lunar missions have faced delays. While technically possible, the probability of meeting this aggressive schedule is low.
